title: More room for GPT-5 Mini responses
summary:
GPT-5 Mini got room for longer answers, daily Pollen refills got a safer check, and community apps got better link previews.

GPT-5 Mini’s maximum completion tokens increased from 1,024 to 16,384, allowing longer responses. A follow-up corrected its provider routing.

The bulk refill now tracks whether the job has run independently of individual login refills, so one person’s refill no longer causes the job to skip everyone else. The microbe tier is included too.

Eleven app pages received updated descriptions or sharing metadata, with refreshed preview and install assets. The app catalog’s build and deployment layout was reorganized around its registry.

daily.title: Longer GPT-5 Mini responses
daily.text: `gpt-5-mini` now supports up to 16,384 completion tokens, up from 1,024, for answers that need more room. [Browse GPT-5 Mini](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-mini).
